newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Direct shipping at designated Chinese and Taiwan ports expected in April
-- President Lee Teng-hui's meeting with the Dalai Lama confirmed, China warns Taiwan against admitting Dalai Lama
-- Government stakes in the three largest state-run commercial banks may be allowed to fall below 51 percent to boost privatisation program
-- President Lee Teng-hui hints at not running for third term
-- President Lee Teng-hui says he will not run for presidency again
-- The Big Three state commerial banks expected to release shares to market
-- China to approve seven Taiwan shippers to operate cross-strait direct shipping business on April 17
-- Stakes in The Big Three state commercial banks may be allowed to fall below 51 percent
-- Taiwan stock market still red-hot, but fund market bearish
